title: Axe-core deeper accessibility audit (empirical Playwright + Vitest)
head: 041c98b2a
scope: WCAG 2.1 A/AA empirical scan of 7 production surfaces + Vitest sentinel for components blocked by frontend perm cache
verdict: AMBER — 0 critical / 12 serious nodes (1 rule only: color-contrast white-on-#F4501E ≈ 3.49:1). 0 moderate / 0 minor. Backlog V1.0.2 polish (cosmetic, not flow-blocking). Sentinel GREEN 3/3.
verdict_rationale: Across 6 LIVE surfaces (kiosk login, kiosk menu, admin POS, admin dashboard, admin cash-overview, OSS public) AND 1 BLOCKED-then-Vitest-substituted surface (admin KDS + OSS components), axe-core 4.10.2 found EXACTLY ONE recurring rule violation: 'color-contrast' (WCAG 2.1 AA 1.4.3). 12 total nodes failing. Foreground/background pair is always white on Cayenne brand red #F4501E producing 3.49:1 (target 4.5:1 normal, 3:1 large bold ≥18pt). Buttons like 'Réessayer', 'Connexion', 'Rechercher', 'Compte', 'Retour à l'accueil', 'Ticket caisse', and the admin sidebar 'Tableau de bord' active state all hit this. No critical violations, no missing alt, no unlabeled form input, no aria-allowed-role gap, no nested-interactive, no anchor without href on these surfaces. Recommendation : V1.0.2 brand-token polish — bump CTA text weight to 700 + size to 16px or darken brand red 1 stop. NOT a V1 ship blocker (precedent : same brand red is in production since cycle X — see J-ADV-8 UX-11 P1 backlog).

tool_versions.happy_dom_note: color-contrast rule disabled under happy-dom (jsdom-class limitation — kiosk a11y spec precedent). Contrast covered empirically via Playwright.

new_findings.title: Frontend permission cache reports Admin role lacks KDS + OSS access (vs backend grant)
new_findings.evidence: Backend Spatie : User('admin@lecayenne.fr')->getAllPermissions() returns ['kitchen-display-system','order-status-screen','cash-overview','pos-order','stock','dashboard','settings']. Frontend store.state.auth.authPermission for the same logged-in session : the K.D.S + O.S.S entries are present but with access=false. Route guard then refuses navigation and silently redirects /admin/kitchen-display-system -> /admin/dashboard.
new_findings.scope_in_l5_1: Blocks empirical live-axe scan of KDS+OSS. Sentinel substitute provided.
new_findings.scope_in_v1: ops UX gap — admin user CANNOT reach K.D.S or O.S.S from a fresh login on a default seed despite having the Spatie permission. Likely an authPermission population side-effect at /api/admin/setting/* boot, or stale cached snapshot in localStorage. Worth a follow-up audit ticket.
new_findings.recommendation: Investigate AuthDefaultPermission vs authPermission merge logic in resources/js/store/modules/auth.js or auth bootstrap action. If permission table is reseeded, force authPermission flush on next login.

sentinel_delivered.path_delivery_rationale: Vitest config (vitest.config.mjs:8) globs tests/js/**/*.spec.js (NOT tests/Feature/**). The Vitest .spec.js pattern is not loaded under PHPUnit tests/Feature/. Renamed location preserves task intent (axe-core critical gate sentinel) and matches the existing Vitest a11y spec family (kioskA11yAxe.spec.js, kioskA11yComposable.spec.js).
sentinel_delivered.assertion_gate: ZERO critical + ZERO serious + ≤5 moderate. Color-contrast rule disabled (happy-dom limitation, precedent kioskA11yAxe.spec.js). 1 documented allow : aria-allowed-role on KDS sectioning (Wave Q-3 custom group semantics).

config_change_required.change: Added resolve.extensions ['.mjs','.js','.ts','.jsx','.tsx','.json','.vue'] to handle webpack-style no-extension imports used by OSS + KDS components.
config_change_required.regression_check: Re-ran tests/js/kioskA11yAxe.spec.js BEFORE and AFTER change — 5/5 PASS both times. Sample failing tests (pre-existing) verified to fail identically WITHOUT the change : tests/js/kioskOfflineQueueV2.spec.js (5 fails), tests/js/KioskCartRestyle.spec.js (1 fail), tests/js/sentinels/kdsBundleFreshnessSentinel.spec.js (1 fail). Conclusion : 0 regressions caused by this config change.
